_note: Register fragment for publication-plain-language-and-translation (REQ-PPL-001). Adds a plain language summary with its reading level and its provenance to the publication. The provenance is written by the server only: PlainSummaryCheck stamps it on every save that changes the summary and restores it on a save that tries to write it. The provenance names a user, so anonymous readers of a public publication do not see it.

plainSummary.title: Plain language summary
plainSummary.description: What this publication is about, in plain words for every reader.

plainSummaryLevel.title: Reading level
plainSummaryLevel.description: The reading level the plain language summary is written at.

plainSummaryProvenance.title: Origin of the plain language summary
plainSummaryProvenance.description: Who wrote the plain language summary, with which text assistant, and who accepted it.

generatedBy.title: Written by
generatedBy.description: A person, or a text assistant whose draft a person accepted.

provider.title: Text assistant
provider.description: The text assistant that wrote the draft. Absent for a text a person wrote.

acceptedBy.title: Accepted by
acceptedBy.description: The person who accepted the summary.
